verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance aggregator, so handing linked-account credentials to third-party processors is a fair question for it. The evidence shows Belvo's own payment products (Pix payment initiation, direct debit, smart collections, balance webhooks). These are adjacent first-party features, and nothing in the pack documents processor tokens, token exchange, or partner integrations that pass verified account details to external processors or platforms.
